run_fairseq_training: run the fairseq training CLI to train a new model on one or multiple GPUs
run_training_with_profiling: run the fairseq training CLI with CUDA and NVTX profiling enabled for performance analysis
review_main_training_loop: review the main training loop that sets up tasks, builds models, and runs epoch-based training
review_train_epoch: review the train function that trains the model for one epoch and returns validation losses
review_validate_function: review the validate function that evaluates the model on validation subsets and returns losses
